whyMeCards.title: Top performer at Universidad Central — twice over.
whyMeCards.body: 8th-semester Systems Engineering. Awarded two concurrent scholarships: one for top national ICFES scores, one for academic merit at the university. Not just meeting the requirement — meeting it with a proven performance record.

whyMeCards.title: Evidence, not claims.
whyMeCards.body: I designed this system from scratch — Blueprint Pass: custom color tokens, typographic hierarchy, motion choreography. No template used. The visual bar here is high. That's by design.

whyMeCards.title: Real production responsibility — not tutorials.
whyMeCards.body: Developer at PGD: GCP + Azure microservice architectures in actual enterprise deployments. Architectural decision-making, not just implementation. When the tech lead is out, the work ships.

whyMeCards.title: B2 certified — you've been reading the demo.
whyMeCards.body: Certified English B2. This entire section is in English. Comfortable with async technical documentation, product discussions, and conversations with Danish founders.

whyMeCards.title: The schedule was designed for exactly this.
whyMeCards.body: 8th-semester student on a part-time track. The 40–50% progile specifies isn't a constraint — it's the exact structure I'm already in. Zero scheduling friction on day one.
